text:
noah: Hey — quick Q. I'm tuning alerts for dedicated pool `eu-west-1-batch`. Which signal should I really trust as the 'saturation' indicator? dashboards/alerts are kinda noisy.

maria: For that pool we usually look at `pool_running_slots / pool_total_slots` + `queue_pending_count`. If running_slots is sticky near total_slots and pending climbs, you're saturated.

sunita: Also watch `gpu_steal_seconds_total` and `steal_queue_length`. Steal is deceptive: short spikes happen with scheduling, sustained steal means nodes are overwhelmed.

liam: If you want a single alert, I prefer a composite: high running_ratio for >5m AND pending_count > 10. Example PromQL I used:

```promql
avg_over_time((sum by(pool) (pool_running_slots) / sum by(pool) (pool_total_slots))[5m:]) > 0.92
and
avg_over_time(sum by(pool) (queue_pending_count)[5m:]) > 10
```

liam: That filters out short bursts. Adjust thresholds per-pool.

noah: Nice. Where do I find the raw traces when I see pending_count spike? I want the pod/instance ids to correlate with node metrics.

maria: Look in Jaeger: https://jaeger.redwood.internal/search?service=autoscaler&pool=eu-west-1-batch. For logs we use Kibana: https://kibana.redwood.internal/app/kibana#/discover?_a=(query:(match:(pool:eu-west-1-batch))).

observability-bot: FYI — saved dashboard: "Dedicated Pools / eu-west-1-batch" updated 2026-06-12 by sunita.

sunita: If you're debugging a specific spike, capture a short time window and run this curl to pull scheduler logs (on ops host):

```bash
curl -sS "https://ops-api.internal/pools/eu-west-1-batch/logs?from=2026-06-12T10:30:00Z&to=2026-06-12T10:40:00Z" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $OPS_TOKEN" | jq .
```

sunita: That returns instance ids, start/end of tasks, and preemption events — useful to correlate with steal.

noah: Any gotchas for alert fatigue? We had a flood last month when we alerted on CPU steal alone.

liam: Yup — CPU steal alone = noisy. Combine metrics, and include a suppression window after an autoscale event (we scale-up events temporarily tick steal). Also add a backoff: only notify if >3 alerts in 30m.

maria: Add owner/team tag in alert body and a direct link to the pool dashboard and recent Jaeger trace (template variables). Makes triage much faster.

noah: Cool, I'll draft a PR with the composite rule + suppression. Ping me if you want to review.

liam: Happy to review — send PR link here. :thumbsup:

maria: One more tip — for historical saturation trends, use `increase(pool_task_rejections_total[1d])` to catch throttling that doesn't show in running_slots.

noah: Great, thanks everyone. I'll open the PR and paste the dashboard + trace links in the alert description.
